_comment: The 3-D prop registry for the briefcase system — every GLB the reward loop renders, and how it is made.
scripts/generate-briefcase-models.mjs reads this to drive Meshy; scripts/build-models.mjs reads it to decimate
scripts/validate-models.mjs checks lib/rewards/models.ts agrees with it. Bump `version` when a model is
regenerated (the served name changes, the old file goes) and mirror the bump in lib/rewards/models.ts.
`image` is the 2-D render the mesh is lifted from (image-to-3D, Meshy 7) — the same art the review wall
shows, so the 3-D set inherits the shipped art direction instead of re-rolling it from a sentence. `texture`
steers the material pass; `prompt` is the text-to-3D fallback for a slug with no usable image (`--route text`).
`fit` is the largest bounding-box dimension the client scales every model to. Meshy normalises its exports to
a ±0.95 box and the hand-made v1 set happened to match, so 1.9 is a no-op today — it is declared so that the
ceremony's framing is a property of the code rather than of whatever the last generation happened to produce.
